# Hi, I'm Julian Betancourt Cuervo 👋

**Lead QA Automation Engineer · Playwright SME · AI-Assisted Testing** — Bogotá, Colombia 🇨🇴

I design, build and scale test automation that teams actually trust. 11+ years in QA, 4+ leading:
from Selenium and Cypress suites to running a QA Center of Excellence that standardized Playwright
for E2E and API testing. Today I focus on bringing AI into testing responsibly — MCP-driven test
generation, self-healing, and evaluating LLM-powered products.

> 🇨🇴 Ingeniero líder de automatización de QA. Mi sitio también está en español: [julianbeta.github.io/es](https://julianbeta.github.io/es/)
